88.why: Passes split B/C (both LOW). A ray falling along the normal has angle of incidence and angle of reflection 0 degrees, which is not an option. Defective as printed; B kept as the setter's likely reading (the reflected ray makes 90 degrees with the mirror).
88.reasoning: When light falls perpendicularly on a plane mirror it travels along the normal, so the angle of incidence is 0 degrees and the angle of reflection is also 0 degrees: the ray goes straight back along its own path. None of the options says 0 degrees. The reflected ray does make an angle of 90 degrees with the surface of the mirror, which is the nearest reading of the options.
88.notice: As printed, no option is right: light falling perpendicularly on a plane mirror is reflected straight back, and its angle of reflection is 0 degrees. Option (2) 90 degrees is the angle the reflected ray makes with the mirror's surface. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.

133.why: Passes split D (MED) / C (HIGH). Checked the figure: (1), (2) and (3) each have one dot in each compartment, and (3) is the same box turned on its side; (4) alone has both dots in one compartment. Rotation does not make a figure different in these items, so D.
133.reasoning: Look at where the dots sit. In figures (1), (2) and (3) the box is split into two parts and each part has one dot. Figure (3) only looks different because the box is turned on its side. In figure (4) both dots are in the same part, so figure (4) is the odd one out.

28.why: Checked: in a perfect cube every prime factor occurs in groups of three (a multiple of three times); C is the textbook answer.

61.why: Both 'a little' (B) and 'a lot of' (C) are grammatical with the uncountable noun English; B fits 'every day' best.
61.notice: Two options fit here: (2) 'a little English every day' and (3) 'a lot of English every day' are both correct with an uncountable noun like English. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.

75.why: Checked: gullible = easily deceived; its opposite is cynical (distrustful). Trusting is a synonym; clever and resourceful are not opposites.

80.why: Checked: unicellular eukaryotes such as Amoeba and Paramecium have organelles, so 'found in multicellular organisms only' is the incorrect statement.

118.why: Of ALL the earth's water, easily usable fresh water is well under 1%. NCERT Class 8 says about 1% of FRESH water is fit for use, so a setter copying that figure may intend C.
118.notice: Of all the water on Earth, the fresh water easy to use is far less than 1%, so PYQ Vault marks (4). The NCERT Class 8 book says about 1% of the fresh water is fit for human use, which is where option (3) comes from. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.

122.why: Checked: the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act was passed by Parliament in 2005 (NCERT Class 8, Understanding Laws); it came into force in 2006. 'Became a law' = passed, so C.

137.why: The series has one K-G-N (letters 18-20) and one N-G-K (letters 13-15). 'K and N adjacent on both sides' counts both: 2. If only the order K-G-N counts the answer is 1 (C).
137.notice: The paper prints option 5 twice, as (1) and (2). The series has one K G N and one N G K; PYQ Vault counts both, since the question only asks for K and N on either side of G, giving 2. If only the order K G N counted, the answer would be 1. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.
